purpose: Raw-free aggregate evidence for broader fidelity design experiments

relationship_to_public_release.description: These experiments tested related advisory layers and host-controlled publication prototypes. They do not measure an overall accuracy rate for the public LLM Accuracy or Deterministic Data plugins.

advisory_native_experiment.result: No incremental numeric accuracy benefit was demonstrated for the added advisory warning.
limits: Hook emission does not prove model use of the warning

deterministic_boundary_probe.result: The tested boundary enforced its declared source-bound output contract.
limits: Fault injection rather than independent model observations
Source truth and source selection were outside the guarantee
The boundary covered a narrow declared contract

count_definitions.native_comparison_calls: One current-setup call and one proposed-setup call for each of four authored cases.
count_definitions.canary_calls: One setup check confirming that the expected advisory hook loaded before the comparison calls.
count_definitions.paired_cases: Four authored evidence packets, each run once in the current and proposed setups.

partial_input_case.definition: A required input was unavailable, so independent facts remained available while the dependent calculation was withheld.

multi_domain_publication_experiment.deterministic_test_definition: Local tests of the prototype publication boundary, not independent model-accuracy observations.
multi_domain_publication_experiment.result: The protected factual panel preserved supported facts, while free-form explanation remained outside the guarantee.
limits: Four authored pairs are not an accuracy-rate estimate
Natural-language source routing was not tested

public_evidence_boundary.reason: Only sanitized aggregate outcomes are published; private runtime material and raw conversations are excluded.

conclusion: Advisory guidance can improve reasoning behaviour but did not establish a general accuracy lift. Deterministic publication enforced declared facts inside the tested boundary, while arbitrary prose remained unverified.
